listing.name: Kamen Rider: Battride War — Battride War native port (robertoqimin)
listing.summary: Upstream October25 status reports intro/title/menus/opening cutscene and STG02 gameplay, with STG02 completed manually and return to mission select; the rest of the game remains unplayed. End-to-end tested route is Fedora/Ryzen54600H/GTX1650; Arch container build and Ubuntu22.04 import-helper checks are separate. Scripted STG02 v0.4.x AppImage measurements average47.9 guestFPS on4600H/GTX1650; crowded manual fights had lower historical rates and audio breakups. A transient untextured polygon remains; full game, sessions overabout30min, clean exit on every path and ATRAC audio are unvalidated. Broad CPU/GPU/distribution tables describe checks, not equivalent gameplay verification; SteamOS remains likely/unverified. No Portcove runtime/gameplay qualification is established. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: JapanBLJS10220 owneddisc/ELF+assets; exactEBOOT digest in docs/BUILD

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README advertises v0.4.1 AppImage containing tools/public sources and optimization profiles, not a compiled game. It imports the owned Japan BLJS10220 ISO using a pinned official RPCS3 import helper, translates the owned EBOOT and compiles locally with its bundled toolchain; original game data remains needed. First launch needs the helper download unless already present, about8GB RAM/8GB free space, and an estimated15–60min compile (12–14min measured on4600H). Build is reused until AppImage version or CPU changes. Manual source generation/CMake build is also documented; no new release asset or build was verified in this review.
